response.overview: Malvin, a student who secretly loves his classmate Evelyn, finally manages to get close to the girl of his dreams through an unexpected incident. Their relationship slowly develops into a sweet love story. However, an incident occurs that takes Evelyn away forever. Only memories and messages Evelyn once gave him remain, Malvin tries to change his life for the better as proof of his sincere love and as a way to repay Evelyn's kindness.
response.title: Your Pen
